title: How to use AI for sales prospecting
description: Ask a chatbot for leads and half of them are made up. Strawberry is a free AI browser that finds real companies that fit, with a reason and a source for each.
introduction: Ask ChatGPT for a list of leads and you get something that sounds right. Then you check it, and half the companies are too big, out of business, or never existed.

Strawberry does the prospecting itself. It's a free browser with an AI companion built in, so it searches LinkedIn, niche directories, job boards, and funding news the way you would, only across dozens of pages at once. You get companies you can actually call, each with the reason it fits and a link to prove it.

sections.title: Leads with a reason, not just a name

blocks.text: Every company comes with enough to decide in a few seconds whether it belongs on your list.

rows: No guessing which Acme it means
Why it fits, in one line

Click through and check it yourself

demo.prompt: Find 30 Nordic fintechs that just raised a Series A and are hiring their first sales lead

items.context: Describe your best customers and get a first sample of prospects, each with a reason it fits.

sections.title: Found where lead databases don't look

blocks.text: The companies worth calling often show up at the edges of the web first: a job post for the role your product replaces, a funding announcement, a listing in a niche directory. Shared lead databases rarely have any of that, and everyone else is buying the same list.

Strawberry works in a real browser, logged in as you. It can search LinkedIn and Sales Navigator, follow the links, and keep digging when the first page comes up short. It paces itself on LinkedIn so your account stays safe.

sections.title: Right on the first run, better on the next

blocks.text: You don't need a perfect ideal customer profile. Strawberry can learn who you sell to from your website, your CRM, and the deals you've won. It shows you a small, varied sample first, you say what's right and what isn't, and the big run goes to the right companies.
Once the search works, save it as a skill. Next time, it starts from everything you've already agreed.

From the list, Strawberry can research the strongest accounts, find the right people, and draft outreach that sounds like you, learned from your own sent emails. Nothing gets added to your CRM or sent without your say.
Put the search on a Routine and Strawberry looks for new companies every week, skips the ones you've already seen, and posts the best to your team.

demo.title: New leads
steps: Searched funding news and job boards

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3. The goal isn't more leads. It's a pipeline that keeps finding the customers you can actually help.
